text:
The biggest question around Quinn Hughes isn't on the ice. He leads Daily Faceoff's ranking of the 2027 free-agent class, and every week brings another headline about whether Minnesota keeps him. On the ice there is no question at all: 27 points in 20 games, 11 on the power play, a nine-game point streak, and nearly 29 and a half minutes a night over his last ten.

The Wild get 58% of the expected goals (the quality of the chances) at five on five with him out there, ten points better than without him. That's not a hot month. Evolving-Hockey had him first among 215 defensemen last season at 4.9 wins above replacement, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking put his primary shot assists in the 99th percentile.

The one part to discount is the goal column: 6 goals on 3.5 expected, shooting 11.8% against a usual range nearer 6%. The playmaking is the real thing. Watch the minutes: a coach leaning this hard on one player tells you what he's worth.
headline: Quinn Hughes, contract year, best of his life
